purpose: Freeze the smallest family-safe test of whether a predeclared CatBoost configuration screen and three-seed averaging materially improve the reproduced fixed MapLight development baseline without changing its representation.
hypothesis: A small frozen nested screen and three-seed averaging reduce fixed MapLight variance or underfitting enough to pass the preregistered global and endpoint-harm gates.
targeted_failure: The fixed MapLight baseline is a single-seed, lightly configured CatBoost model; the simplest falsifier is that nested tuning and seed averaging fail to improve at least 8 of 15 outer cells or miss either effect-size threshold.
occam_boundary: Use only the accepted 2,563-column MapLight representation and the twelve parent configurations. Do not add a feature, learner, calibration, stack, endpoint-specific grid, early-stopping rule, or thirteenth configuration. A clean rejection retains fixed MapLight and stops EXP-G1 without repair from outer outcomes.
targeted_failure_modes: V1/V2 molecule, exact-duplicate, or D-032 component leakage across outer or inner folds
V3 configuration, iteration, seed, preprocessing, calibration, or threshold selection outside inner component folds
V4 feature, fold, target, runtime, CatBoost parameter, or seed drift
V6 treating tutorial MA-ST-RAE as a live-backend official score
C6 changing the accepted MapLight representation or resolved configuration semantics
P5 partial publication, nondeterminism, retry, resume, overwrite, or fit-budget reuse
P6 confirmatory, historical-row, blinded-test, TDI, external, submission, metric, leaderboard, or upload contamination

accepted_development_inputs.read_boundary: This contract freeze authenticates only tracked receipt strings. It opens no corresponding private or official file. A later claim-bound execution contract must reauthenticate every parent before any parse.

reproduced_baseline.name_boundary: The tracked values are family-safe development diagnostics. G2-3 must recompute paired baseline and candidate metrics on identical frozen rows. Neither this receipt nor any later tutorial metric is an official challenge score or confirmatory evidence.
reproduced_baseline.immutability: The consumed G2-2 attempt cannot be retried, resumed, moved, overwritten, or refit. G2-3 consumes its exact immutable baseline predictions only.

population_and_splits.rule: Remove confirmatory components and preserve every accepted group_folds.csv outer and scoped inner assignment exactly. Never rebalance, reseed, or use endpoint availability or outcome.
population_and_splits.family_invariant: No similarity_component_hash may cross a training/validation boundary in any outer or inner cell. Exact molecule identities and duplicate forms inherit their component boundary.
population_and_splits.metric_preflight: Before fitting, the scorer alone must prove at least one tutorial-eligible row and a positive finite tutorial denominator for every endpoint in every inner selector population and complete-repeat outer population. Failure publishes G2_3_G1_UNDERPOWERED with zero fits; it never changes a fold, mask, bound, or target.

runtime.parameter_rule: Every constructor contains only its exact frozen configuration, common arguments, and current model seed. No eval_set, early_stopping_rounds, use_best_model, callback, warm start, continuation, snapshot, or outcome-dependent iteration choice is permitted. Synthetic acceptance must bind the resolved parameter receipt for every configuration form.

feature_contract.nan_policy: Preserve only the accepted descriptor NaN mask; CatBoost 1.2.1 must resolve nan_mode=Min. Reject any other nonfinite feature or resolved behavior.
feature_contract.forbidden: No scaling, imputation, dimensionality reduction, feature selection, clipping, calibration, representation concatenation, or external/pretrained feature is part of EXP-G1.

screen.uniformity: All twelve configurations and all three seeds apply to every endpoint and outer cell. The observed CYP1A2 and CYP2D6 weakness may motivate the lane but cannot change the grid, metric, tie break, or endpoint acceptance rule.

fit_and_prediction_budget.unused_capacity_rule: The sixty-fit difference is intentionally unused and cannot fund a retry, repair, replacement configuration, extra seed, baseline refit, or exploratory diagnostic.

capability_and_stage_contract.trusted_compiler: Authenticate all accepted parents before parsing the same in-memory bytes, assign the label-free development partition before target parse, and publish immutable disjoint cell capabilities.
capability_and_stage_contract.inner_model: May read only one configuration, one seed, the current inner-training target rows, and matching training/prediction features. It cannot resolve inner validation truth, outer validation truth, baseline predictions, metric code, another cell, or confirmatory paths.
capability_and_stage_contract.inner_freezer: Freezes all three seed predictions for one configuration and inner cell, verifies exact identity and row receipts, and computes the seed mean with math.fsum in ascending seed order divided by three. It reads no truth.
capability_and_stage_contract.inner_selector: Only after every configuration prediction for the outer cell is frozen, may read inner-validation point/lower/upper truth and the matching frozen predictions. It cannot read outer-validation truth. It emits one immutable endpoint selection token.
capability_and_stage_contract.outer_model: May read only the selected configuration token, one seed, outer-training target rows, and matching training/prediction features. It cannot resolve outer-validation truth, inner selector truth, baseline predictions, metric output, or confirmatory paths.
capability_and_stage_contract.outer_freezer: Freezes three selected-seed predictions, verifies exact identity and selection lineage, and computes the seed mean with math.fsum in ascending seed order divided by three. It reads no truth.
capability_and_stage_contract.outer_scorer: Only after all candidate outer predictions are immutable, may read development outer point/lower/upper truth plus exact fixed-MapLight outer predictions. It emits aggregate development evidence and no row-level public artifact.
capability_and_stage_contract.global_configuration_freezer: May derive one future full-development configuration per endpoint only from the complete selection-only inner cross-fit projection. That token cannot alter any EXP-G1 outer prediction and grants no confirmatory or model-fitting authority.
capability_and_stage_contract.prediction_identity: Every prediction row binds contract, source, feature, fold, endpoint, configuration, seed, model, molecule, component, stage, and selection-token receipts. Any duplicate, omission, cross-cell row, or forged identity fails the whole attempt.

nested_selection.outer_cell_rule: For each repeat, outer fold, and endpoint, average the three seeds before scoring. For each configuration, pool its four inner-validation folds for that outer-training population. Select lower endpoint tutorial ST-RAE, then lower endpoint component-macro MAE, then lexicographically lower configuration_id. Refit only that selected configuration under all three seeds on outer training.
nested_selection.tutorial_mask: Use only rows with finite central point and finite reported lower and upper bounds. The identical immutable truth mask is used for all configurations and the fixed baseline. Missing values are excluded, never imputed.
nested_selection.component_mae_tie_break: Use every finite central point in the same outer-training inner OOF population, with equal total weight per D-032 component within endpoint. This is a tie break only during inner selection.
nested_selection.numeric_policy: Use float64, math.fsum over explicitly sorted records, no clipping or rounding before comparison, and exact configuration_id as the final tie break. Any nonfinite prediction, score, or nonpositive tutorial denominator fails the attempt rather than dropping a configuration or row.
nested_selection.complete_selection_projection: For each configuration, repeat, molecule, and endpoint, first average its three seeds within each of the four outer contexts in which that molecule is outer-training and inner-validation, then average those four context predictions with math.fsum in ascending outer-fold order divided by four. This produces one cross-fitted prediction per repeat, molecule, endpoint, and configuration without an extra fit.
nested_selection.future_endpoint_configuration: After EXP-G1 outer evidence is terminal, select one future full-development configuration per endpoint on the complete selection projection by lower endpoint tutorial ST-RAE, then lower endpoint component-macro MAE, then configuration_id. This selection is for a later contender freezer only; it cannot enter or revise EXP-G1 or EXP-G2 development outer predictions.
nested_selection.forbidden_feedback: Outer scores, endpoint diagnostics, component errors, q90 values, bootstrap results, confirmatory truth, test data, and leaderboard observations cannot change an inner selection, configuration, seed, iteration count, or later outer prediction.

development_evaluation.paired_identity: Candidate and fixed-MapLight comparisons require the exact same molecule, endpoint, component, repeat, outer-fold, truth-mask, and scorer rows. Any missing, extra, duplicate, reordered-without-canonicalization, or cross-system identity fails before a metric is computed.

primary_metric.repeat_rule: For each repeat, join all five outer folds into one complete OOF prediction per development molecule and endpoint. Compute the four endpoint tutorial ST-RAE values and their arithmetic macro mean; the experiment primary value is the arithmetic mean of the three repeat macro values.
primary_metric.relative_improvement: (fixed_MapLight_primary - G1_primary) / fixed_MapLight_primary. A nonpositive or nonfinite baseline fails closed.
primary_metric.name_boundary: This is the pinned tutorial metric only. Live-backend parity is unverified and no local value may be called an official score.

component_macro_mae.repeat_rule: Within each endpoint and repeat complete OOF population, give each D-032 component equal total weight divided across its finite central rows. Average the four endpoint values, then the three repeat values.
component_macro_mae.endpoint_harm: For each endpoint, compute G1 minus fixed MapLight after averaging its three repeat component-equal values.

development_evaluation.favorable_cells: For each of the 15 repeat-by-outer-fold cells, macro-average the four endpoint component-equal MAEs. A cell is favorable only when G1 is strictly lower than fixed MapLight on identical rows.

paired_component_bootstrap.difference: G1 component-macro MAE minus fixed MapLight component-macro MAE
paired_component_bootstrap.unit: D-032 component shared across endpoints, repeats, and both systems
paired_component_bootstrap.draw: Sample the sorted union of scored development components with replacement at the original component count. Retain every eligible row and all three repeat predictions for each drawn component with multiplicity and recompute both systems and their difference.
paired_component_bootstrap.rejection: Reject a draw when either system lacks an eligible endpoint row or any result is nonfinite.
paired_component_bootstrap.interval: Sort accepted differences and linearly interpolate p=0.025 and p=0.975 using h=(n-1)*p.

acceptance.logic: Every member is conjunctive. Equality passes the numeric minimum or maximum gates except the paired upper bound, which must be strictly below zero, and favorable cells, which require strictly lower candidate error.

development_evaluation.decision: A complete pass publishes G2_3_G1_ACCEPTED and may advance only to a separate EXP-G2 contract. A complete miss publishes G2_3_G1_REJECTED, retains fixed MapLight, and permanently stops EXP-G1 without grid expansion or outcome-driven repair.

terminal_contract.publication: Only aggregate receipts, counts, selected configuration IDs, metrics, resource use, accounting, authority, and decision may enter Git. Row-level targets, bounds, structures, predictions, residuals, and component memberships remain private.
terminal_contract.failure: Any incomplete fit set, failed configuration, receipt or identity mismatch, family/capability leak, nonfinite value, budget breach, forbidden counter, nondeterminism, partial publication, cleanup defect, crash, or interruption is terminal G2_3_G1_FAILED. No retry, resume, move, overwrite, or replacement attempt is authorized by this contract.
terminal_contract.rejection: A scientifically clean completed rejection is authoritative negative evidence and cannot authorize a larger MapLight grid, extra seed, altered loss, endpoint-specific repair, or repeated EXP-G1.

resource_ceiling.concurrency: A later execution contract must freeze bounded process concurrency and prove peak resource accounting synthetically before official fitting.

requires: reviewed signed integration and green post-main CI for this exact contract
a separate additive G2-3B synthetic implementation contract
two fresh deterministic synthetic replays covering family isolation, capabilities, all configuration forms, selection, scoring, accounting, cleanup, and terminals
reviewed signed integration and green post-main CI for exact accepted implementation hashes
a separate additive G2-3C execution contract and single immutable claim

next_gate: Implement only a distinct additive G2-3B synthetic fixture, least-privilege capability compiler, nested selector, deterministic freezer, scorer, and terminal publisher. Bind future implementation hashes only after two fresh synthetic replays and adversarial review. Do not open official inputs, fit an official model, evaluate a development metric, or create an execution claim during this contract milestone.
